name: Cledis German Romero
crime: Charged: BOSTON – A Dominican man unlawfully residing in Salem, Mass. was charged by criminal complaint allegedly unlawfully obtaining approximately $16,000 in MassHealth benefits and aggravated identity theft. Cledis German Romero, 40, has been charged with healthcare benefit fraud and aggravated identity theft and appeared in federal court in Boston on Nov. 3, 2026.
